name: print-social-business-summit-calendar-poster-charcoal-with-orange-dates
title: Charcoal 'Business Summit' calendar poster with a 5x3 grid of sessions and orange date numerals
whatItIs: A portrait charcoal poster with 'SUMMIT' and large 'BUSINESS', an orange date range, and three timeline rows with orange arrowed lines and times, each holding five sessions with uppercase titles on grey highlight bars, lorem text and big orange day numbers, plus a QR code and contacts.
whatItMeans: Dense but ordered; the timeline rows make a festival of sessions feel manageable.
techniques: Run orange timeline rules with times above each row.
Place big date numerals under each session.
Close with a QR code for details.

vocabulary.definition: A line with markers showing time order.
